what: The progress bar of the bottom strip (white panel · 3px top line): ticks are spaced evenly per section, and the moment a section’s start rises offset (260px, 66px on narrow screens) from the bottom of the screen, the bar tip reaches that section’s tick (straight fill between ticks). At the bar tip a vehicle (bus image) runs wearing the current section’s label on its head, facing forward when going down and turned back when going up. When entering a section group the strip rises from below in .3s ease (on leaving, after a .3s delay over .3s). The vehicle runs in 2% late from 100px outside left over .6s and exits to the right at the end. The label switches off in .2s and the new one switches on .1s late over .3s. Dragging the vehicle scrolls straight to that spot.

options.[data-fx-part=fill]: Filling bar (child) — its parent is the bar track (8px rounded line)
options.[data-fx-part=rider]: Slot for the towed vehicle (child) — illust and labels go inside
options.[data-fx-part=illust]: Vehicle graphic (optional) — enters, exits, and turns around
options.[data-fx-part=labels]: Spot for a custom section name tag (optional)
options.[data-fx-part=ticks]: Spot to build and insert section ticks (optional) — if absent, the bar is divided evenly
options.container: Section group CSS (wraps from the first section to the last), default main
options.sections: Section css, default [data-rider-name] — the name tag text is data-rider-name
options.footer: Footer css (optional) — places the bar end where the group’s bottom edge sits at 50% of the screen + half the footer height
options.offset: How many px a section’s start must rise from the bottom of the screen for it to count as current, default 0 — original 260
options.offset-narrow: Offset for narrow screens (narrow and below) — original 66
options.api: Global name of the smooth-scroll object (window[api].scrollTo(y, { immediate }) — Lenis). If absent, moves the window (or data-fx-scroller) directly
options.refresh: Delay (ms) from when a section height changes and settles until the scale is re-measured, default 300. The original calls refresh 300ms after pressing collapse. 0 means immediately
options.--fx-rider: Vehicle size (css), default 40px (30px on narrow screens)
options.--fx-away: Distance vehicles are pushed when entering and leaving (css), default 100px (48px on narrow screens)
options.data-on · data-status · data-dir · data-: Whether the band is up (1·0) · vehicle state (0 before · 1 entered · 2 passed · 3 returned) · scroll direction (down·up) · current section name — attached to the element for the user’s css to pick

use: — Per section
note: The vehicle has touch-action: none because dragging is the whole point, and it blocks default actions while pressed — only the vehicle (40px) does this, the rest of the band and the page still scroll. When section height changes (accordion·font), tick positions are re-measured with ResizeObserver.

from.where: index.html .sy-rider — original #jsScrollbar (.cScrollbar): ScrollTrigger start top svh · end bottom (svh*.5 + footer/2), second check for state 2%·.525, activeOffset 260px (SP 66px), linear interpolation between ticks, bus drag lenis.scrollTo immediate
